responsibility: Provides the x86 DragonFly BSD target configuration header for ELF systems. It sets DragonFly-specific assembler syntax conventions, debugger register mapping, profiling conventions, ABI type sizes, dynamic-linker spec variables, long-double rounding behavior, stack-check support, default 32-bit CPU baseline, and exec-stack note emission, making it the OS-adaptation layer that tailors the generic i386 backend to DragonFly userspace.
